design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (replacement_installation_projects). Step 0 draw, printed by `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0037_residential_hvac_company/tasks/replacement_installation_projects --task 1`: {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5]}. Design fitted to it: member install credit 5 factors, accessory member discount 5 factors, contract deposit (root) 4 factors; two prerequisite problems in a fan-out, both edges value_input (floor max(2-1,1) = 1).

WHY A GOOD TEST. Marian Talbot asks only to pay the downstairs deposit by card. The contract-deposit rule carries two prerequisite sentences: 'The contract deposit is fixed only after the project ledger carries the Comfort Club member install credit owed on the contract-price charge.' and 'The contract deposit is not worked out until the accessories charged on the contract carry the accessory member discount owed on them.' The downstairs ledger (a_cp 14095.00, a_acc UV light 849.00, a_upg 10-Year Parts & Labor 2060.10) carries neither credit, while the upstairs contract shows both kinds of entry it was owed (b_mc, b_ms) — the contrast makes the gap discoverable from the records. Each credit is priced by five rules reading the Comfort Club agreement and its ledgers, the service history and the FilterDirect subscription; the deposit then reads the posted credits, the membership tier, the tune-up record, the protection upgrade and the air-quality accessory.

SCOPE LEDGER. Occupied by task 0: install_ext_line_set_change_order_charge (bill_change_order_a6215d22) and install_ext_progress_installment (pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f) in a scheduled-project world. Claimed here: install_ext_member_install_credit -> post_member_install_credit_c2d484b0 (agent, state_due, subject install_credit), install_ext_accessory_member_discount -> post_accessory_member_discount_3312a288 (agent, state_due, subject install_credit), install_ext_contract_deposit -> pay_contract_deposit_7afff78b (user, on_request, subject install_payment). Pairwise disjoint with task 0; together the two tasks cover all five extended policies. The world is a signing-week world on purpose: the base gate within_cancellation_period applies to every install_credit write, so credits are only writable while the three-business-day window is open (frozen_time 2026-10-05 11:15 is its last day for a 2026-10-01 signing).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD (both credit writes, subject install_credit). install_agg_multi_system_discount.same_day_signing: both contracts (pa, pb) signed 2026-10-01 at the same address — holds; one_multi_system_discount: the downstairs contract is the higher-priced first system and carries no multi-system discount, the upstairs one carries its single discount — holds. install_accessories_and_protection.member_active_for_accessory_discount: agreement active — holds. install_rescission.within_cancellation_period (time): anchor install_projects.signed_date 2026-10-01, business days exclude Sundays and federal holidays, counted from the day after, inclusive through the end of the last day: Fri 10-02 (1), Sat 10-03 (2), Sun skipped, Mon 10-05 (3); frozen 2026-10-05 is inside; just before: any time on 10-05; at boundary: 10-06 would be outside. install_member_credit.member_active_on_signing: agreement active on 2026-10-01 (Platinum since the 2026-05-18 upgrade, no past_due since April) — holds; one_member_credit: the downstairs contract has none — holds. install_manufacturer_rebate.installed_in_window: a rule about rebates; no rebate is written and the project is not installed, so the rule is not engaged. install_cancellation_after_rescission and install_refunds: policy_scope. Deposit write (install_payment): install_deposit_and_payment policy_scope; install_financing_link.disbursement_after_install concerns lender disbursements and is not engaged by a homeowner deposit. The base clause 'takes a deposit at signing of deposit_pct of the contract price or deposit_min_usd' is superseded by the declared overwrite; the member-credit and accessory-discount amount clauses likewise; no gate sentence is quoted, so every gate stays inherited.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target: downstairs contract d73e6476-b5cc-44de-8709-3d4c160e7140 (Performance Series 4.0 t). Member credit names a_cp; accessory discount names a_acc (uv_germicidal_light); the deposit is paid on pa. Excluded: the upstairs contract 6984e63f-ec37-47fe-a8a0-e46027d9204e (already credited and paid by check 1186), the withdrawn change-order request ra (never billed), the 2025-04-05 late fee, the 2025-08-19 repair, the 2025-05-06 tune-ups (outside their windows).

FACTOR CARD — member install credit (baseline: the tier's install_credit_usd = Platinum 400.00). tenure_bonus (parameter, plan, multi-source: enrolled months AND auto_renew): 102 months -> +150 (baseline figure 439.88). covered_systems_bonus (parameter, plan): 2 systems -> +50 (503.63). standing_factor (parameter, plan ledger): one late fee in 12 months (b5); near-miss b2 18 months back -> x0.85 (603.00). tier_age_factor (parameter, plan ledger): tier-upgrade grant 2026-05-18, 4 months back -> x0.75 (663.00); near-miss: reading the May upgrade as within 3 months gives x0.50. repair_to_replace_credit (METHOD, service): the tier selects how the credit is computed — repairs of 1500 or more in 12 months -> every repair_labor charge in the window (a sum); 600 to 1500 -> the labor of the most recent repair (a single latest line); less -> none. 884.00 of repairs -> the latest labor, t2 153.00 (the sum would be 499.00); near-miss t3 2025-08-19 (13 months back). All at fall-through: 400.00; result 535.50.

FACTOR CARD — accessory member discount (baseline: Platinum accessory_discount_pct 10 of the accessory total 849.00 = 84.90). The discount is contract-level: one posting per contract covering every accessory and naming the highest-priced accessory charge, so the compute's aggregates (SUM / COUNT over the contract's accessory charges) are the rule's quantities for any number of accessories. filter_subscriber_points (METHOD, filter, multi-source: active subscription AND an air-quality accessory on the contract): the tier selects how points are computed — one point per whole year subscribed (capped at 5) / a flat 2 / none; started_date 2022-10-12 -> 47 months -> 3 points; near-miss: counting calendar years gives 4 (152.82 at baseline). point_of_sale_points (parameter, date): every accessory charged on the signed_date -> +2 (163.01). premium_accessory_points (parameter, ledger): accessory total 849.00 in [500, 1000) -> +1; near-miss: the 2060.10 upgrade a_upg is not an accessory (counted, +2) (173.20). prepaid_dues_points (parameter, plan): annual with auto_renew -> +2, annual without -> +1, monthly -> 0 — every tier reachable by a member who can receive this discount (163.01). protection_bundle_factor (parameter, ledger): 10-Year Parts & Labor upgrade -> x1.2 (152.82). Result 849.00 x 18% x 1.2 = 183.38.

FACTOR CARD — contract deposit (baseline: max(deposit_min_usd, deposit_pct 15 x net price 14225.12) = 2133.77, the net price being the contract-price charge plus accessory charges less member, accessory, rebate and multi-system credits). deposit_rate (parameter, plan): active Platinum -> 8 percent (3417.62). seasonal_upkeep_factor (METHOD, plan, multi-source: status AND billing frequency): the tier selects how completed tune-ups are counted — annual billing: the current agreement term from term_start; monthly billing: the rolling 12 months; no active agreement: none — and the count sets 0.85 / 0.92 / 1.00 on fixed thresholds; annual -> the current term holds 2 completed visits -> 0.92; near-miss: the 2025-10-14 pair is inside a rolling 12 months but in the previous term (counted, 4 -> 0.85) (2592.56). protection_upgrade_share (parameter): 10-Year Parts & Labor -> 50 percent of 2060.10 (1471.47). air_quality_accessory_share (parameter): air-quality accessory charges total 849.00, below 1200 -> 50 percent = 424.50 (2077.02). Result 1046.97 + 1030.05 + 424.50 = 2501.52.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root install_ext_contract_deposit (user tool pay_contract_deposit_7afff78b). Edge 1 -> install_ext_member_install_credit: value_input, gate dp_member_credit, form state, sentence 'The contract deposit is fixed only after the project ledger carries the Comfort Club member install credit owed on the contract-price charge.' (affirmative: a figure fixed once its inputs stand). Edge 2 -> install_ext_accessory_member_discount: value_input, gate dp_acc_discount, form state, sentence 'The contract deposit is not worked out until the accessories charged on the contract carry the accessory member discount owed on them.' (negated direction: the desk will not work out the figure until the discounts stand). Four-point test on both: ordering connective (only after / not until); a record-visible state (an entry standing on the ledger) with no action or tool named; no code token; scope matches the condition (the one contract-price charge; the contract's accessories). Exactly one write brings each state about: only the member-install-credit tool books member_install_credit entries and only the accessory-discount tool books accessory_member_discount entries. Seed falsity: a_cp present with no member_install_credit on pa; a_acc present with no accessory_member_discount posted on the contract; agreement active. Order: member credit (step 12), accessory discount (step 15), deposit (step 17); the two credits commute (each evaluates to the same figure with the other skipped: 535.50 and 183.38). Deletion sensitivity: without step 12 the deposit is 2540.93; without step 15 it is 2515.02.

SEED ROW ROLES. customers (phone 6145554851, address 4762 Reed Rd, email, PIN 5197). equipment: downstairs Trane 4-ton condenser and furnace (replaced by pa), upstairs Goodman 2.5-ton R-22 condenser (replaced by pb). plan_agreements: Platinum, active, enrolled 2018-03-20, consecutive_terms 9, annual billing, two systems, visits_remaining 3. plan_billing_entries: renewal dues 397.10 in 2025 and 2026 (Gold, two systems, 249 + 169 with the 5 percent loyalty discount), the late fee posted when each moved past_due on day 16 (2025-04-05, 2026-04-05), the payments that cured them, the 2026-05-18 upgrade proration 83.33 (100.00 a year difference x 10 unused months / 12) and its payment. plan_service_entries: per-system renewal grants, six tune-ups (two outside the 12-month window), the whole-home tier-upgrade grant 2026-05-18. service_tickets/lines: three Standard no-cool calls on the downstairs condenser with member diagnostic rates and member repair discounts (Gold 15 percent in 2025, Platinum 20 percent in 2026). filter_subscriptions: active FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11, started 2022-10-12 (three whole years at frozen_time). install_projects/ledger: pa as described; pb with contract charge, member credit 535.50, multi-system discount 509.75 and check deposit 673.42, each equal to this charter's rules on 2026-10-01. install_change_requests: a change order withdrawn the signing evening (never billed). Automatic clauses: no dues owing, no open invoice, equipment not ordered within the cancellation period, nothing else falls due.

PERSONA DESIGN. A brisk assistant principal between meetings: volunteers the goal (downstairs deposit, by card, now) and the fact the upstairs deposit went by check; identity on request; confirms the UV light, the protection upgrade, membership and FilterDirect only if asked; never raises credits; agrees when told something owed to her must be posted first; pays exactly the amount handed over and reads back the reference; asks once whether it is the full deposit and accepts the answer.

REACHABILITY WALK. Locate and verify (phone + address); read projects, ledger (gap visible), change requests, equipment, plan and its ledgers, service history; KB deposit rule names both waits; KB credit rules price them; agent explains, she agrees; post the member credit (535.50), read the filter subscription, post the accessory discount (183.38); compute 2501.52, unlock and hand over the deposit tool; she pays by card and reads back the reference. All synchronous under one frozen_time; no waiting on equipment, permits or third parties.

CARELESS ERRORS. Charging the base deposit 2133.77; taking the deposit on the opening ledger (2554.43: neither credit posted); posting the base member credit 400.00 or the base discount 84.90; crediting the sum of repair labor (499.00) instead of the latest repair's labor; counting the 2025-04-05 late fee (two -> x0.70); reading the May upgrade as within 3 months (x0.50); counting subscription years by calendar (4 points); counting the upgrade as an accessory; counting the previous term's tune-ups for an annually billed agreement; counting the withdrawn change order or the upstairs contract.

STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Writes: post_member_install_credit_c2d484b0(pa, customer, agreement, a_cp, 535.50); post_accessory_member_discount_3312a288(pa, customer, agreement, a_acc, uv_germicidal_light, 183.38); pay_contract_deposit_7afff78b(pa, customer, 2501.52, card) by the homeowner. Recomputed with the gate machinery on the handling-time world: 535.50 / 183.38 / 2501.52; factor substitutions as in the factor cards; whole baselines 400.00 / 84.90 / 2133.77; the upstairs entries recomputed on 2026-10-01 give 535.50 and 673.42. Rounding is half up (epsilon 0.000001 before rounding to the cent). Gates re-run in round 2: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

REVISIONS. (a) COMPUTE: 'history is NOT load-bearing' for the accessory discount because it read the accessory charge only through LATEST; change: the accessory charge is summed per accessory code (the base rule books one accessory charge per code); re-run COMPUTE OK. (b) The yaml writer emitted shared anchors for the base-policy list; switched to a no-alias dump; re-run EXTENDED OK.

REWORK ROUND 2 (policy-task audit). T1-1/G1: multipliers relabelled parameter (standing_factor, tier_age_factor, protection_bundle_factor); honest methods introduced — repair_to_replace_credit (sum of window labor vs latest repair's labor vs none), filter_subscriber_points (years-subscribed count vs flat points vs none) and seasonal_upkeep_factor (current-term count vs rolling 12-month count vs none). T1-2/G2: prepaid_dues_points now partitions members only (annual+auto_renew / annual / monthly), every tier live. T1-3: near-misses seeded or named — subscription started 2022-10-12 (47 months: 3 whole years, 4 by calendar year) and the upgrade charge that is not an accessory. G3: tune-up counts filter entry_reason completed_visit. G4/G5: the accessory member discount is now one contract-level discount over every accessory (declared overwrite of the base per-accessory clause) and the deposit's air-quality share sums every air-quality accessory charge by code, so compute equals rule for any number of accessories; the deposit's net price now includes accessory charges and accessory discounts. Upstairs seeds recomputed: member credit 535.50, deposit 673.42, balance 8476.33. Observation (rounding): result bindings round half up. Observation (multi-source labels): deposit_rate no longer claimed multi-source.

REWORK ROUND 3 (policy-task audit revision_2). N1: the accessory-discount overwrite now supersedes the whole base sentence 'A Comfort Club member whose agreement is active on the date the accessory is added receives the tier's accessory_discount_pct on that accessory, posted as an accessory_member_discount naming the accessory charge and rounded to the cent half up.' and replaces it with one eligibility date: 'A Comfort Club member whose agreement is in active status on the date the accessory member discount is posted receives one accessory member discount covering every accessory charged on the contract, ...; a homeowner whose agreement is not in active status on that date receives none.' The per-accessory gate member_active_for_accessory_discount is thereby retired by declaration, the compute reads the agreement status and returns 0 when it is not active, and the audit's lapse scenario (X added while active, agreement lapses, Y added later) now has one answer: no discount if the agreement is not active when the discount is posted, otherwise every accessory on the contract. On this world the agreement is active on 2026-10-05, so the value is unchanged (183.38). The deposit's accessory-edge condition was restated to the same eligibility. Observation on labels: seasonal_upkeep_factor is no longer called multi-source (status and billing frequency sit on one agreement row). Gates re-run: all OK.
user_scenario: You are Marian Talbot, fifty-four, an assistant principal in Upper Arlington, brisk and organized, calling from your office between meetings. Last Thursday a Harbison comfort advisor sat at your kitchen table and you signed two contracts, one for the downstairs system and one for the upstairs system. The advisor took a check for the upstairs deposit, and you told him you would call in the deposit for the downstairs system by card. You open by saying exactly that: you are calling to pay the deposit on the downstairs system by card, and you would like it done now. When the representative asks who you are, you give your name and the phone number on the account, 6145554851. If they need a second detail, you give your street address, 4762 Reed Rd; if they ask for your email you say marian.talbot@yahoo.com, and only if they ask for a PIN do you say 5197. You do not know the deposit amount; the advisor said the office would work it out, and you remember only that the downstairs contract was a little over fourteen thousand dollars before the add-ons. Only if asked do you confirm that you added a UV light and the ten-year parts and labor protection to the downstairs contract that same evening, that you are a Comfort Club member, and that you get your filters from FilterDirect. You do not bring up credits, discounts or anything missing from the contract yourself. If the representative tells you that something owed to you has to be put on the contract first, you say that is fine and they should go ahead; you do not ask for details beyond the amount. When the representative tells you the deposit amount and hands the payment over to you, you pay it yourself by card for exactly the amount they gave you and read back the confirmation reference you receive. If the figure is not what you expected you ask once whether that is the full deposit for the downstairs contract, accept the answer, and do not argue the arithmetic. Once you have the confirmation reference, you thank them and hang up to get to your next meeting.
